title: Indiana National Guard drawsdown from tornado damage support
description: Interviews from Indiana National Guard drawsdown from providing support to community after tornado devastation. U.S. Senators for Indiana Dan Coats and Dick Lugar give interviews as well as Indiana Adjutant General, Maj. Gen. R. Martin Umbarger.
keywords: Indiana National Guard, tornado, Senators, state active duty, Dick Lugar, Dan Coats, damage

transcript.text: Most of the 250 Indiana National Guard troops activated for tornado relief in Henryville,
Indiana, head back home as the mission is handed off to local responders.
Senator Dick Luger and Senator Dan Coates accompany Major General R. Martin Numbarger
Well, the National Guard is the basic foundation for our state of Indiana and the great leadership
that General R. Martin gives, and Joe Davis gives and others.
It's terrific to see it in action once again.
Soldiers from the 1-1-5-2 cab, HHT, Alpha Troop, Charlie Troop, and Delta 113, and the
2-1-5-1 infantry, HHC, Bravo, Charlie, and Delta Company, provided presence patrols
and water distribution points during their time in Henryville.
Reporting for the 120th Public Affairs Detachment, I'm Specialist Antelio Archer.
